attr.title: retsend
attr.desc: Transfer files between handhelds, phones and PCs over local Wi-Fi, using the LocalSend protocol. Works with the official apps. Received ROMs go into their respective console folders; everything else goes into the ROMs root folder (configurable in Settings).
attr.inst: Ready to run. Install LocalSend (https://localsend.org) on your phone or PC, or retsend on another handheld. Connect both devices to the same Wi-Fi, and they will find each other.
attr.inst_md: Ready to run. Install [LocalSend](https://localsend.org) on your phone or PC, or retsend on another handheld. Connect both devices to the same Wi-Fi, and they will find each other.
